source: Compendex with a retained paired Inspec projection
objective: Run one consolidated readiness pilot over all nine current Boolean partitions with the approved Compendex F(P) wildcard translation, no proximity, strict paired Compendex and Inspec capture, and both mandatory adapter v16 screenshots. Confirm current B2 and the changed BG1, BG2, BC1, and BT2 definitions before any final search.

pilot006.outcome: A1, A2, A3, and B1 completed. Current B2 then stopped on one unverified next-page transition, so the predeclared stop rule left the consolidated run incomplete.

historical_gaps.interpretation: Pilots 003 and 006 remain immutable. Pilot 007 starts every partition again as a fresh source event. The critical gaps run first, and all nine events must still pass.

scope.decision_target: Compendex readiness for a later final search
scope.inspec_projection: Retain and validate the Inspec records separately because the fixed paired route selects both databases. This Compendex pilot does not approve an Inspec wildcard translation or create an Inspec final search.

date_window.cutoff_handling: Screen records in the cutoff year against the later exact common cutoff.

controls.native_ris: required for every retained record in each strict pass

translation.literal: ("ordinary token or ordered phrase" WN ALL)
translation.boolean: uppercase AND and OR with explicit parentheses

population_block.status: approved for all nine Compendex schedule entries

compound_definitions.F(G_model): F(G_model_fixed) OR F(G_mission_exact) OR (F(G_mission) AND F(M_B))
compound_definitions.F(G_structure): F(G_structure_fixed) OR F(G_product_exact) OR F(G_variation) OR (F(G_product) AND F(M_B))
compound_definitions.F(T_precise): ordinary union of all 32 precise tailoring terms

schedule.A2: F(P) AND F(E_F) AND (F(M_H) OR F(M_B))

critical_live_checks.B2: Must complete a fresh strict paired event. A null, partial, inferred, or reused result fails readiness.

acceptance_checks: All nine fresh events complete two independent source-exhaustive paired passes.
Every event uses exactly three approved trailing population wildcards and no proximity operator.
Every event preserves exact query, database, Published-year, language, autostemming, sort, page-size, and no-facet readback.
Every retained record reconciles against native RIS in both strict passes and has one database-scoped stable accession.
Compendex and Inspec totals, accessions, and unions remain separate.
Every event retains a configured-search screenshot and verified-first-results screenshot whose hashes and dimensions match the JSON receipt.
B2 completes with a non-null strict result.
BG1, BG2, BC1, and BT2 each complete with the current compound definition.
No event or union is treated as a final search.

execution_order.basis: Run B2 and the four changed definitions before repeating the partitions that already completed in Pilot 006. This ordering changes no query or acceptance rule.

stop_rules: Run events once in the predeclared critical-first order.
Stop after the first source, strict-capture, screenshot, control, or artifact failure.
Do not retry, narrow, infer a count, resume a pass, or reuse a prior source result.
Retain a create-only non-mergeable failure receipt and any screenshots already captured.
